title: UV Crosslinking of Adherent Cells for eCLIP
author: Eric Van Nostrand
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.z6zf9f6
materials: Gently resuspend until the sample is homogeneous

steps.title: Prepare Plate for Cross-linking
steps.instruction: Prepare the tissue culture plate for UV exposure by cooling and removing the lid.

substeps.instruction: Place the tissue culture plate on leveled ice or a cooling block pre-chilled to 4°C.
Place the plate and cooling block into the UV cross-linker, ensuring the plate is leveled.
Remove the tissue culture plate lid.

steps.title: UV Cross-link Cells
steps.instruction: Cross-link the cells using 254-nm UV light.

substeps.instruction: Set the energy to 400 mJoules/cm² (Note: this may be a setting of 4000 on cross-linkers displaying values in 0.1 mJoules/cm²).

steps.title: Wash and Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the cells and scrape them from the plate into a conical tube.

substeps.instruction: Wash the plate gently with 1x DPBS at room temperature (15 mL for a 15 cm plate).
Add enough 1x DPBS to just cover the plate (5 mL for a 15 cm plate).
Wash the plate once more with 10 mL of 1x DPBS and add the wash to the same 50 mL tube.
While keeping the cells on ice, use a cell scraper (Corning, CLS3010-10EA) to scrape the plate.
Transfer the cells to a 50 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Quantify and Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Determine cell concentration and resuspend to the required density.

substeps.instruction: Count cell concentration using an automated cell counter or hemocytometer, ensuring cells are well-resuspended.
Resuspend cells in the desired amount for flash freezing (typically 20×10⁶ cells per mL).

steps.title: Concentrate and Aliquot Cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells and transfer them into smaller tubes.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the 50 mL conical tube at 200g for five minutes at room temperature.
Spin down at 200g for five minutes at room temperature.
Transfer the desired amount (typically 1 mL of 20×10⁶ cells per mL) into 1.5 mL Eppendorf Safe-Lock Tubes or equivalent.

steps.title: Flash Freeze and Store
steps.instruction: Freeze the cell aliquots in liquid nitrogen and store at low temperature.

substeps.instruction: Freeze by submerging the epi-tubes completely in liquid nitrogen.
After frozen (at least thirty seconds), remove from liquid nitrogen and store at -80°C.
